title: Total influence sum
statement: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube. Then $I(f)=\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}I_i(f)$. For a real cube function $h$, define $I_i(h)=\tfrac14\mathbb E_x(h(x)-h(x^{(i)}))^2$, where $x^{(i)}$ flips coordinate $i$ and $\mathbb E_x$ is uniform expectation, and $I(h)=\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}I_i(h)$.
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function of arity n
replaced:
The total influence is the sum of the coordinate influences:
$I[f] = \sum_{i} \mathrm{Inf}_i[f]$.
